staleness_cases.title: Multi-field validation Field Name display on Results screen
staleness_cases.tail:
in `validationUtils.tsx` resolved Field Name only from `standard_format_field_id`. For multi-field validations, this FK is `NULL`, producing a bare `-` with no context for operators to understand which fields are validated.

# Approach

**Implemented in dipdash PR [#1034](https://github.com/aclaimant/data-pipline-dashboard/pull/1034):**

1. Fall back to the `used_columns` array (already populated by the backend) when `standard_format_field_id` is NULL.
2. Render columns as a comma-separated list, truncated to 3 items with a `+N more` suffix for longer lists.
3. Hovering the truncated badge reveals the full list via tooltip.

## Files changed (PR #1034)

- `web/src/components/containers/combinedValidationTable/combinedValidationTable.tsx`
- `web/src/utils/validationUtils.tsx`
